title: Acceptance: Persistence with Fallback
prompt: Build save_expenses(path, expenses) + load_expenses(path): JSON roundtrip with ensure_ascii=False; missing file -> []; corrupt file -> []. Then demonstrate: save one Vietnamese-noted expense ("cà phê"), load it back, and print the LOADED amount (one line).

tests.name: survives everything
tests.code:
import json as _j, os as _os
for p in ("cap_probe.json",):
    if _os.path.exists(p):
        _os.remove(p)
assert load_expenses("cap_probe.json") == [], "missing -> []"
open("cap_probe.json", "w").write("{oops")
assert load_expenses("cap_probe.json") == [], "corrupt -> []"
_os.remove("cap_probe.json")
assert printed == ["3.5"], f"print the loaded amount, got {printed}"
assert "ensure_ascii=False" in code, "Vietnamese must stay readable"
tests.hint: try/except around json.load catches JSONDecodeError; FileNotFoundError catches missing.
